verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card, so real-time spend visibility by team, category and merchant is a fair question for it. The evidence pack covers only rewards rates, partner perks, card request flow and withdrawals. Nothing documents real-time spend tracking, dashboards, or breakdowns by team, category or merchant.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land
